Header: Rice Yellow Mottle Virus Ikivejuru in Kinyarwanda

Prevention: Weed the field in order to remove alternative hosts
Surround the plot with water to prevent rodents moving through the crop to avoid the spead of the disease
Plant the seedling at spacing of 20cm between both rows and seedlings to reduce contact between plants
Avoid movement of animals (cow, goats, etc.) in the field
Monitoring: RYMV symptoms starting at nursery stage
Observe for yellowish streaking of leaves and stunted plants
Initiate control when you notice one infected plant
Direct Control: Uproot and burn infected plants just when one plant is infected
Avoid exchange of farming materials like hoe, panga, etc. in order to reduce the spread of virus
Burn after harvesting infected rice straws
Restrictions: There is no chemical to control viruses.
